title: High-Protein Low-Calorie Chicken Pizza Pocket (71g Protein)
originalTitle: High-Protein Low-Calorie Chicken Pizza Pocket (71g Protein)
ingredients: 225g (8 oz) extra-lean chicken breast mince (ground chicken breast)
1 tsp garlic powder & 1 tsp Italian seasoning
1/2 tsp kosher salt & 1/2 tsp black pepper
60ml (1/4 cup) tomato passata or pizza sauce
Fresh torn basil leaves & 1/2 tsp avocado oil spray
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and place the ground chicken breast between two sheets of parchment paper; roll or press into a thin, even oval crust.
Peel off the top parchment and season the chicken oval with garlic powder, Italian seasoning, salt, and black pepper.
Spread tomato passata, light mozzarella, and fresh torn basil across one half of the chicken oval, leaving a 1/2-inch border.

Use the bottom parchment paper to fold the bare half of the chicken over the filling and crimp the edges tightly to seal. Top with grated Parmigiano-Reggiano and oil spray, then bake 20 minutes (broiling the final 2 minutes) until golden and 165°F internally (455 kcal, 71g protein).
